themes.title: Right-wing parties challenge voting rules and electoral integrity
themes.blurb: Right-wing and populist parties across Sweden, the US, and Norway are challenging voting rules, electoral procedures, and political participation. From Sweden Democrats making claims of electoral fraud over missing ballots to new mail ballot restrictions in the US and proposals limiting political participation in Norway, voting integrity remains a primary battleground.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD raised claims of electoral fraud after finding its ballots missing at an early voting station.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: USPS implemented new Trump-ordered restrictions on mail ballot delivery ahead of the midterms, while MAGA figures face ongoing legal consequences over election claims.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Frp proposals to limit certain forms of political participation drew public concern and criticism.

themes.title: Internal divisions challenge right-wing party unity
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in the US and Norway are navigating internal debates, local pushback, and ethical questions that threaten party cohesion. Disagreements over Trump family conflicts of interest and agricultural tariffs in the US mirror local policy confusion and public friction surrounding Frp positions in Norway.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national polls
themes.blurb: Polling trends across Sweden and the US highlight how voter sentiment is shaping strategy for right-wing candidates and coalition partners. While Sweden Democrats enjoy high acceptance among coalition voters compared to left-wing parties, US polling reflects mixed reactions to Trump policies alongside persistent base loyalty.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Polling shows voter opposition to proposed administration health policies, even as Trump campaigns to bolster midterm candidates.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Conservative policy proposals in the US and Norway focus heavily on social spending reforms, welfare programs, and labor integration. Opposition lawmakers in the US contest cuts to school mental health services, while Norway's Frp champions major workforce integration initiatives.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump

themes.title: Populist right relies on energetic rallies and loyal base
themes.blurb: Mobilizing enthusiastic crowds and maintaining a steadfast core base remain key strategies for populist leaders in Sweden and the US. Both Jimmie Åkesson and Donald Trump rely heavily on personal appearances and devoted grassroots followings to generate momentum.
